name: Student Search Report to Superintendent
description: Immediate report of any search to the Superintendent, followed by a written record of time, date, individuals involved, reason, results and other pertinent facts.
deadline: immediately; written record as soon as possible
quote: A report of any search shall be made immediately by the administrator to the Superintendent followed as soon as possible by a written record, containing the time, date, individuals involved, reason for the search, results, and all other pertinent facts.
